Full credit to @alexcooperadcrate for the original framework, I automated the whole thing inside Claude Code.

This is for DTC brands and creative agencies who need high-volume static ad creative without briefing a designer or spending hours in Canva. Hope you guys enjoy!

@alexcooperadcrate video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ibzfKRRSHhU&t=27s
fulltitle: How To Create Stunning AI Image Ads with AI (Claude Code + Nano Banana 2)
